name: DP-GES Rendering
aliases: Depth Peeling for High-Fidelity Gaussian-Enhanced Surfel Rendering
definition: A rendering method that combines 2D surfels with semi-transparent boundaries and 3D Gaussians to achieve high-fidelity, sort-free Gaussian splatting with correct transmittance modulation, eliminating aliasing and popping artifacts.
summary: DP-GES Rendering is a sort-free method combining 2D surfels with semi-transparent boundaries and 3D Gaussians to achieve high-fidelity novel view synthesis without aliasing.
